manifesto.headline-line-2: A NEW HOME FOR THE GAME.

headline: THE FASTEST-GROWING
SPORT ON EARTH.
movement.paragraph: Born in Mexico, perfected in Spain, padel is now sweeping Asia. From Singapore to Bali, from Kuala Lumpur to Bangkok, a new generation is picking up the racket. Da Nang is next.

headline: FOUR COURTS.
ONE STANDARD.
courts.paragraph: Panoramic glass walls. World Padel Tour-grade surface. Professional LED lighting designed for high-performance play. Our four indoor courts are built to international competition standards, accessible to everyone from beginners to pros.

headline: RECOVER
LIKE A PRO.
wellness.paragraph: A dedicated wellness area built around what athletes actually need: a Finnish sauna, an ice bath, a stretching zone. Recovery isn't a luxury. It's part of the practice.

headline: WHERE THE GAME
CONTINUES.
lounge.paragraph: Specialty coffee, healthy food, and a workspace built for digital nomads. Whether you stay for a coffee or a full afternoon, the lounge is the social heart of Oasis.

headline: BUILT FOR THE
NEXT GENERATION.
academy.subtitle: Oasis Padel Academy — Da Nang's first dedicated padel school for kids and adults.
academy.paragraph: A program built with international coaches and local talents. Open to children from age 6. Scholarships for promising young Vietnamese players. Because the future of padel in Asia will be written here, by them.
